def bare_prefix_controls():
    """Twelve pure controls for the sole grammar expansion; no raw journal or child access."""
    def row(message):
        return {"_BOOT_ID":BOOT_COMPACT,"__REALTIME_TIMESTAMP":str(LOW_US+1),
                "__MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMP":"965864000000","_TRANSPORT":"kernel","MESSAGE":message}
    def project(message):
        return fixed_template_descriptor(row(message),KERNEL_SOURCE,"0"*64)
    passed=[]
    def ok(name,condition):
        need(condition,"BARE_PREFIX_CONTROL_FAILED")
        passed.append(name)
    private="PRIVATE_CMDLINE_SENTINEL account=987654321"
    bare="Control message: Processed ctl.start for 'surfaceflinger' from pid: 830 ("+private+")"
    item=project(bare)
    control=item["control_template"]
    ok("bare_complete_public_template",control is not None and control["operation"]=="start" and
       control["target_role"]=="surfaceflinger" and control["reported_caller_pid"]==830 and
       control["caller_cmdline_bytes"]==len(private.encode("utf-8")) and
       control["caller_cmdline_sha256"]==hashlib.sha256(private.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() and
       private not in json.dumps(item) and "987654321" not in json.dumps(item))
    ok("bare_and_original_prefix_same_labelled_fields",project("init: "+bare)["control_template"]==control)
    ok("reported_caller_never_signal_sender_or_host_identity",
       item["process_attribution_proved"] is False and item["cause_proved"] is False and
       control["PID_space"]=="Android_init_reported_not_host_attribution")
    foreign=project("PRIVATE_PREFIX "+bare)
    ok("foreign_prefix_still_not_authority",foreign["control_template"] is None and foreign["closed_prefix"] is None)
    ok("unlabelled_number_not_caller",project(bare.replace("from pid: 830","from 830"))["control_template"] is None)
    unknown=project(bare.replace("'surfaceflinger'","'com.private.account'"))
    ok("private_service_still_not_exported",unknown["control_template"] is None and
       "com.private.account" not in json.dumps(unknown))
    ok("trailing_bytes_reject_full_template",project(bare+" ignored")["control_template"] is None)
    ok("embedded_newline_not_a_complete_cmdline",project(bare.replace(private,private+"\nsecond"))["control_template"] is None)
    for value,name in [("0","zero_labelled_pid_rejected"),("2147483648","out_of_range_labelled_pid_rejected")]:
        try:
            project(bare.replace("from pid: 830","from pid: "+value))
        except RuntimeError as error:
            ok(name,str(error)=="CONTROL_CALLER_PID_BOUND")
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("BARE_PREFIX_NUMERIC_NEGATIVE_ACCEPTED")
    encoded=(json.dumps(row(bare),sort_keys=True)+"\n").encode()
    projection=project_stream(encoded,KERNEL_SOURCE,True)
    ok("unlisted_tuple_cannot_enter_locked_templates",
       projection["all_retained_bytes_parsed"] is True and projection["known_role_templates"]==[])
    ok("operation_whitelist_not_expanded",
       project(bare.replace("ctl.start","ctl.kill"))["control_template"] is None)
    need(len(passed)==12,"BARE_PREFIX_CONTROL_COUNT")
    return {"passed":12,"cases":passed,"filesystem_access":False,"subprocesses":0,"device_operations":0}
